subject: Several Species tagged for one picture

messages.author: 4110a064d00e2085
messages.subject: Several Species tagged for one picture
parts:
Hello, 

For a lot of my photos , I tagged many species that we can see on the picture. 
So now in my sheets I have 4 columns for species. The second for the species tagged in second, the third for the species tagged in third etc. 

How can I make a graph with the species in all those columns with camtrapR?

Thanks for your help, 

And thanks for this R package very useful!

Isaure Combeuil

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Several Species tagged for one picture
parts:
Hi Isaure, 
camtrapR only uses one species column, and if an image has several species it will results in several rows for the same image (recordTable does that automatically). So I think you'd need to convert your table to the standard format of camtrapR (see data("recordTableSample") and ?recordTable). 
You can convert from your format (wide format) to  long  format used by camtrapR using e.g. reshape2::melt(). camtrapR does not offer a function for this task because the data structure you used is different from the camtrapR standard.

Also, What kind of "graph" do you need? 

If you tagged the images with digiKam, you can probably create a new, properly formatted record table by running recordTable() instead of reformatting your existing table.

If this doesn't help please share a part of your table.

Best regards,
Jürgen
